verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad remote access tool, so a connection audit log is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only a general log reachable via 'Show Log…' or Library/Logs, plus a list of paired devices. Neither is documented as recording who connected to which machine and when, and nothing shows the log can be exported for audit. That makes this an adjacent diagnostic feature, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: On your Mac, choose Show Log… in the Sill menu, or open the Sill folder in Library/Logs in your home folder.
Sill's Settings › Devices on your Mac lists the devices you paired.
